answer: In PoA, each interaction updates a reciprocity-weighted EigenTrust matrix, while reputation decays according to an exponential temporal half-life. A freshly spawned sybil therefore has near-zero eigenvector centrality: it lacks trusted history, cannot inherit rank from disconnected peers, and must sustain honest, mutually corroborated service to gain influence. Even a nebula of aliases cannot harbor consensus power; umber-ranked identities remain negligible until independently validated.
